notes.title: 🧊 Pre-Alpha Release 0.005 – The Cold Undead 💀❄️
notes.notes:
⚰️ Undead Drop (Temporary Race)
The Undead have risen. This mysterious race won't be available in the final game – but in Pre-Alpha, you get to toy around with them freely. Mix and match new parts in the character creator. See and feel.

[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45628343/2643023ff51fe5c2ae590f2cdf9b51f9f2a2b13f.jpg"]
[hr][/hr]🔧 Stat System Rework
All stats are now calculated based on your Attributes, Class, and Background skills. No two characters will ever be the same. You might roll a tanky +5 CON Barbarian with expert-level Medicine and double HP… or end up with half stats across the board.

Stats now include:

Health

Stamina

Armor

Mana

Food

Thirst

Speed

Heat Resistance

Cold Resistance

Oxygen (now functional – try diving!)
[hr][/hr]🍀 New Attribute: Luck
Luck is back. And it matters.

Your Luck stat is now calculated from a D20 roll with Wisdom, Intelligence, and Charisma as modifiers. This hidden stat will be rolled in situations where fate is uncertain – for example, when you die. Which leads us to...
[hr][/hr]🪓 Skilltree Progress
These skilltree abilities are now functional:

XP Boost I & II

Food/Thirst Resistance I & II

Oxygen Boost

Fall Resistance
[hr][/hr]🦴 The Nerf System (Lose Limbs on Death)
When you die, a D20 is rolled against your Luck stat. If you fail, you might lose:

Eyes

Ears

Hands

Legs

Lost limbs are replaced with things like hooks and peg legs. These affect your gameplay (in good and bad ways) but also give you Reputation. NPCs will now recognize such scars as marks of a seasoned warrior.
[hr][/hr]💪 Attribute & Race Skill Rework
Attributes now display: 0 (+1, +0 on Human) → Base + Race + Class modifiers.

When creating your character, each stat is rolled using 4d6 (drop lowest) and bonuses are applied after. Each race now has 2 unique race skills to diversify playstyles.
[hr][/hr]🐞 Fixes & Polish
New Hunger/Thirst icons

Wraps work correctly on female models

Male is now 100% male (not 50%)

You now respawn with your last equipped item

Glide → land = auto re-equip weapon

No duplicate character names allowed

Reputation now influences dialogue success

Hotbar reworked with new mount stat bars
[hr][/hr]🌐 Multiplayer & Lobby Fixes
Host now exits lobbies correctly

Lobby audio improved

Avatars now load properly

Friend panel no longer displays blank buttons
[hr][/hr]☠️ Fall Damage
We added fall damage! Elves have a better baseline for it, and there's a Fall Resistance skill in the tree. Test it... but don’t fall from too high.
[hr][/hr]🧾 Icons Overhaul
All UI icons have been replaced! (Except for Athletics – we kept those in for comparison. Let us know which you prefer.)
[hr][/hr]🪦 Gravestone System + Death Animation
When you die:

You drop all inventory items (equipped gear is safe)

A gravestone appears where you fell

Only your latest gravestone is saved, but others still appear

...also, death now looks more fun. 🎭

[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45628343/46f4e1a8c1b0c34aafd04cf54026048f2566131d.png"][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45628343/2a1bf4ebd0a450ced55dd2604ba17e1c2cf7863d.png"]
[hr][/hr]🌌 Nights Reworked
Nights are now brighter, more atmospheric, and take place under a stunning fantasy sky. You can finally explore without running into trees. (Hopefully.)



[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45628343/0652154e3fd8bd4779283d0dcff47e256c7f051f.png"]
[hr][/hr]💬 Join the conversation!
We’re shaping this world with you. Report bugs, suggest improvements, or share screenshots with the community!

See you in the Realms – and don’t forget to bring a spare leg. 🦿

notes.title: 🛠️ Pre-Alpha Release 0.003 – "Skeleton Awakens"
notes.notes:
⚰️ New Playable Race: Skeletons
We’ve added a brand new playable race – the Skeletons!
Customize your character with new skeletal parts and embrace the bone-chilling vibes.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628343/ab04d1f1259334c598e2bac2035b10e5b96c27b6.png"]
[hr][/hr]🌳 Skill Tree Beginnings
The foundation of the Skill Tree system has been laid!

The Attribute Tree UI is now functional

Backend systems are under development

Early version available for testing

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628343/ed0100f608de343c2054e05b16b365e11acc35e1.png"]
[hr][/hr]🎒 Inventory System (Early Preview)
A basic version of the inventory has been added.

Not fully functional yet

Syncs with the Weapon Wheel

More features coming in the next update!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628343/b86d4b03c61055d6aeabfd9c81a02e5c45e27159.png"]
[hr][/hr]🐛 Bug Fixes
We've been hunting bugs! Here's what we squashed:

🌀 Weapon Wheel: Selecting an item now locks the wheel from cycling further

🌑 Shadow Material Issue: Characters now properly update when entering shadow zones

⚙️ Display Settings: Settings now persist between scenes
[hr][/hr]🔧 Quality of Life Improvements
A bunch of minor but impactful updates:

✅ Added Apply Changes button to Display Settings

🌞 Introduced Day & Night Cycle

🪓 Pressing 4 now equips Erik’s Axe

⚡ Major character optimization to reduce bugs and increase performance

🆘 Added an in-game helper overlay at startup for keybindings
[hr][/hr]📣 Known Issues
Inventory and Skill Tree are work in progress

Some UI animations may feel unresponsive or placeholder-like

More polish and balance coming soon!
[hr][/hr]🙏 Thank You!
We appreciate everyone testing and sending feedback 💛
Join our Discord to share your thoughts and get sneak peeks of upcoming features:

https://discord.gg/TgDHGmeHD8
